description: This file defines the AuthRequest class used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for login and registration requests in the authentication module. It contains email and password fields with validation annotations and corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: AuthRequest
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for passing authentication data (email and password) in login and registration requests.

methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing email and password.
